title: Extreme cardiac MRI analysis under respiratory motion: the CMRxMotion challenge
core_idea: To promote research on the robustness of deep-learning models to respiratory-motion artifacts in cardiac cine MRI by curating and publicly releasing a controlled-motion dataset and organizing a benchmarking challenge with two tasks: automated image-quality assessment (classifying motion severity) and robust myocardial segmentation in the presence of motion artifacts.
tldr: A public challenge and controlled-motion cardiac cine MRI dataset were created to benchmark and drive development of motion-robust deep-learning methods for image-quality assessment and myocardial segmentation.
